title: STARLEAD Black Mirror-Round-Bathroom-with-Lighting 60 cm, Bluetooth, Anti-fog, Mirror-LED with 3 Light Colours, Dimmable, Memory, IP44, HD Tempered Glass, Non-Metallic Frame
feature_bullets: 【Stylish Design and Smart Touch】STARLEAD 60 cm bathroom mirror with lighting that has a black coating on the edges, imitates metal frames and offers a minimalist look without heaviness. 3 separate buttons for lighting, anti-fog and Bluetooth. A soft glow around the buttons illuminates the bathroom at night. You can also turn off this glow by long pressing the on/off button when the LED is off.

【Dimmable and 3 Colour Temperatures】Our LED bathroom mirror with lighting are dimmable (10%-100%) to adjust the light environment to your mood or request. Choose between warm white light (3000K), neutral white light (4000K) and cool white light (6500K) to create the ideal atmosphere for any occasion or preference. Mirrors are extremely clear (CRI>90+), perfectly illuminating every detail and giving you confidence.

【Bluetooth and Memory Function】Experience relaxation with 2 Bluetooth speakers with your favorite music or podcasts. Remember to click the third button to turn off Bluetooth when you don't need it to avoid connections with neighbors. Our bathroom bluetooth mirror remembers your favorite settings. So you don't need to adjust the brightness and color temperature every time.

【Fog-Free & IP44 Waterproof】Get rid of the constant wiping of the mirror! Our illuminated bathroom mirrors have built-in anti-fog pads. The centre of the mirror provides clear reflection even in fogged bathrooms. The LED strip is splash-proof (IP65) and the entire LED bathroom mirror is IP44. So you can count on its longevity, even in daily splashes. Lifespan up to 50,000 hours.

【Easy Installation and Customer Service】Our LED bathroom mirrors are wired for installation. With installation hardware and instructions, installing the mirror is a breeze. We offer a 2 year warranty. Our mirrors are shipped from Germany. Our packaging has been improved several times. If you receive a damaged mirror, it is not necessary to return it. Contact us and we will reply you within 24 hours.

product_details.Included Components: 1 x Mounting Kit, 1 x Round Bathroom Mirror with Lighting, 1 x user manual in five languages
